claims.text: The hotel sits on the Danube river promenade, a 15-minute walk from the historic Old Town.

findings.quote: Positioned on the vibrant Danube river promenade, a scenic 15-minute walk from the historic Old Town

claims.text: The riverside promenade gives a direct pedestrian connection to the historic city center and suits a morning jog, a sunset stroll or a bike ride.

findings.quote: The scenic promenade is perfect for a morning jog, a leisurely sunset stroll, or a bike ride, offering refreshing views and a direct pedestrian connection to the historical city center.

claims.text: ZION SPA Luxury, on the 11th floor, has panoramic Danube views, bespoke treatments, a pool, hot tubs, saunas and a steam room.

findings.quote: ZION SPA Luxury, located on the 11th floor, offers panoramic Danube views, bespoke treatments, a pool, hot tubs, saunas, a steam room, and signature wellness rituals.

claims.text: The indoor pool on the 11th floor has hydro massage, bubble loungers and a jacuzzi with panoramic views.

findings.quote: The indoor swimming pool has hydro massage and bubble loungers and a jacuzzi with panoramic views of the surrounding area from the 11th floor perch.

claims.text: Rooms start at 35 square meters and include high-speed wireless internet, a mini-bar and individually controlled air conditioning.

findings.quote: Spanning 35 square meters or more, each spacious room features wireless high-speed internet, a mini-bar, and individually controlled air conditioning.

claims.text: Suites have marble bathrooms with rainfall showers and bathtubs.

findings.quote: Our luxury suites in Slovakia feature marble bathrooms with rainfall showers and bathtubs.

claims.text: The Grand Living Room on the 9th floor is a lounge for relaxing or working.

findings.quote: Experience the exclusive Grand Living Room on the 9th floor, offering a sophisticated space to relax or work in comfort.

claims.text: Connecting rooms and suites are available for families.

findings.quote: Ideal for families, featuring connecting rooms and suites for ultimate comfort.

claims.text: The top-floor gym has Danube views.

findings.quote: Our top-floor hotel gym offers Danube views and state-of-the-art equipment.

claims.text: Both restaurants have outdoor terraces overlooking the Danube.

findings.quote: Both of our beautiful restaurants in Bratislava have relaxed outdoor terraces with stunning views over the famous Danube River.

claims.text: The hotel was formerly the Kempinski River Park before joining the Luxury Collection in 2015.

findings.quote: This was formerly the Kempinski River Park before joining Starwood's Luxury Collection in 2015.

claims.text: The concierge can arrange a private speedboat tour on the Danube.

findings.quote: Let our Concierge arrange a private speedboat tour for you.

claims.text: The Presidential Suite has handwoven Persian carpets and a bathroom with 24-karat gold tiles, onyx and black marble.

findings.quote: Handwoven Persian carpets grace the floors, while the opulent bathroom boasts 24-karat gold tiles, onyx, and sleek black marble.

claims.text: Guests can arrive by the hotel's private rooftop heliport or private river pier.

findings.quote: For an extraordinary arrival, utilize private rooftop heliport or private river pier.

claims.text: Every suite, from the Junior Suite to the Presidential Suite, has Danube views and access to ZION Spa Luxury.

findings.quote: From the intimate Junior Suite to the grand Presidential Suite, each offers elegant design, stunning Danube views, and exclusive access to Zion Spa Luxury.

claims.text: The Presidential Suite has a 75-square-meter terrace with views of Bratislava and the Danube.

findings.quote: The Presidential Suite features a stunning 75 sq m terrace offering a unique view of Bratislava, the Danube River, and the picturesque surroundings of the hotel.

claims.text: The glass wine cellar at the Lobby Lounge holds more than 300 Slovak and international wines and is the biggest hotel wine cellar in Slovakia.

findings.quote: Impressive glass wine cellar at Lobby Lounge offers more than 300 fine Slovak and international wines and is the biggest hotel wine cellar in Slovakia.

claims.text: Reaching the historic Old Town means a 15-minute walk along the Danube river promenade.

findings.quote: Positioned on the vibrant Danube river promenade, a scenic 15-minute walk from the historic Old Town
a scenic stroll along the Danube River promenade seamlessly leads you directly into the heart of the historic center

claims.text: The spa area is available at an extra charge.

findings.quote: Spa area available at extra charge
